unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 花费(时间、金钱)；度过
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He spends a lot of time fishing.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: s + pend（悬挂）= 花费时间像悬挂着流逝。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 蜘蛛
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He's a spider. He's small.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 蜘蛛 (spider) 有八只脚，爬得飞快。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 精神, 灵魂, 心灵, 本质, 烈酒
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: You have to wear a uniform because it builds school spirit.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法: 死拼(spirit)到底的体育精神。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 勺子
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A spoon of sugar.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sp(视频)+oon(两只眼睛)：用勺子舀着冰淇淋看视频。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 运动；锻炼
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Do a class survey about sports.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: sp(视频)+ort(类似art艺术)：体育运动(sport)是一种可以在视频里播放的艺术。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 展开, 传开 `v.` 展开；扩散；传播；散布
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She used a knife to spread sweet strawberry jam on the bread.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 展开, 传开 v. 展开；扩散；传播；散布。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 春天；春季；温泉
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Here comes spring.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：sprɪŋ 像“死不灵”，春天万物复苏“活了”，不再“死不灵”

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 广场；正方形 `adj.` 正方形的；(表示面积)平方的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Its head is a green square.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: s-q-u-a-r-e 正方形，四条边儿一样长。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 体育场, 运动场
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It's in the new city stadium.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：stad (站，立) + ium (场所) -> 站满观众的地方，即体育场。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 阶段, 段, 步骤, 舞台, 状态 `v.` 组织, 使发生, 举行, 上演
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The school drama club performed a wonderful play on the big stage.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 阶段, 段, 步骤, 舞台, 状态 v. 组织, 使发生, 举行, 上演。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 楼梯
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: And the apples are falling down the stairs!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆法：楼梯(stairs)上放着许多椅子(chairs)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 邮票
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He stuck a colourful postage stamp onto the envelope before posting it.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 邮票。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 站；站立；起立；位于(某处) `n.` 展台；摊位；看台
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Stand up!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 词中词：s + tan（晒黑）+ d。站在太阳底下晒黑（tan）了。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 标准；水平；规范；规格 `adj.` 标准的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Our teacher has set a high standard for our English writing tasks.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 标准；水平；规范；规格 adj. 标准的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 开始；着手(做)；发动；启动(发动机、车辆等)；(使)发生；开始进行 `n.` 开头；开始
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Our morning classes start promptly at eight o'clock every weekday.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 开始；着手(做)；发动；启动(发动机、车辆等)；(使)发生；开始进行 n. 开头；开始。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 状态, 状况；国家；(美国的)州；陈述, 说明
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The old bridge has been kept in very good state for over a century.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 状态, 状况；国家；(美国的)州；陈述, 说明。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 站；火车站；电台
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The metro stations are really beautiful.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 我们国家 (nation) 的火车站 (station) 非常漂亮。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 停留；暂住；逗留 `v.` 停留, 待
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: How long does Tom stay at school?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 停留一下，stay。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 牛排, 肉排
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: For dinner on Saturday, Dad cooked delicious beef steak with vegetables.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 牛排, 肉排。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 偷窃；窃取
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He stole many jewels.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 偷（steal）东西是不对的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 水蒸气, 蒸汽, 轮船 `v.` 蒸发
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: White steam rose into the cold morning air from the hot cup of tea.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 水蒸气, 蒸汽, 轮船 v. 蒸发。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 准备对付, 下定决心 `n.` 钢, 钢铁工业
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Students can climb up steel ladders.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 钢铁（steel）是非常坚固的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (脚)步；台阶；梯级；步骤；措施 `v.` 跨步, 走
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Remember, go straight on, walk 50 steps...
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: s-t-e-p：踏出的每一步都稳稳当当。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 棍, 棒；手杖 `v.` 粘贴；困住；将……刺入
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I want to make a stick for Grandpa Liu.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 生病(sick)时需要木棍(stick)当拐杖。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 还；还是；仍然；依旧；(加强比较级)更 `adj.` 静止的, 平静的；安静的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: But it's still early.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音记忆法 (死盯 - 他还是死死盯着我)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 胃；腹部
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: TO: Sally From: Your stomach
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: sto (石头) + mach (马车) -> 胃里沉得像石头 and 马车一样。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 胃痛；腹痛
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He ate too much ice cream and had a bad stomachache.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 胃痛；腹痛。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 石料, 石头；石块
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: stone lions
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: s(蛇) + tone(声音)。安静的山谷里，一块大石头的缝隙里突然传出了蛇发出的声音。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 使停止；阻止；停止；停下来(做某事) `n.` 停止；车站；停住；停下
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Hey! Please stop!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想/图像记忆法 (想象马路边红色的STOP停车标志牌)

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 商店；店铺；(大型)百货商店 `v.` 储藏；存储；贮藏
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: In order to store honey, they create honeycombs.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 商店 (store) 靠近海岸 (shore)，里边存储了许多物资。
